how_verified: Each figure below was checked against the official page or PDF linked in its program's sources (official administrator domains only: chfainfo.com, chaconline.org, hud.gov, va.gov, rd.usda.gov, larimer.gov, greeleygov.com and the local Habitat affiliates). On 2026-09-27 the pages were read through search-indexed copies of those official pages because direct page fetches were blocked from the build environment. Where a figure could not be confirmed it is left out and the program links to its source instead. Re-verify by opening each source URL (see README).

occupations.co-public-school: Colorado public school or school district employee (preK-12)
occupations.private-school-teacher: PreK-12 teacher at a private school

programs.name: CHFA FirstStep / FirstStep Plus
programs.who_its_for: First-time homebuyers (no ownership interest in a principal residence during the past 3 years) or qualified veterans, buying anywhere in Colorado with a 30-year FHA loan.
key_rules: First-time homebuyer or qualified veteran
Minimum credit score 620 for every scored borrower (borrowers with no score are permitted)
Every borrower completes a CHFA-approved homebuyer education class before closing
Income and purchase-price limits apply by county, household size and targeted area. See CHFA's income limits (effective June 15, 2026)
Can be paired with CHFA down payment assistance

programs.name: CHFA FirstGeneration
programs.who_its_for: Buyers who have never owned a home and whose parents or guardians have never owned a home. Buyers who lived in foster care need only to have never owned a home.
key_rules: You and your parents or guardians have never owned a home (foster-care exception above)
30-year fixed FHA loan with down payment assistance of up to $25,000 as a deferred second mortgage
Minimum credit score 620 for every scored borrower
Income and purchase-price limits apply. See CHFA's income limits (effective June 15, 2026)
CHFA-approved homebuyer education required
programs.fit_note: Only if neither you nor your parents or guardians have ever owned a home.

programs.name: CHFA SmartStep / SmartStep Plus
programs.who_its_for: First-time and repeat buyers using an FHA, VA or USDA-RD loan.
key_rules: Not limited to first-time homebuyers
FHA, VA or USDA-RD loan
Every borrower completes a CHFA-approved homebuyer education class before closing
Income and purchase-price limits apply. See CHFA's income limits (effective June 15, 2026)
Can be paired with the CHFA down payment assistance grant or second mortgage

programs.name: CHFA Preferred / Preferred Plus
programs.who_its_for: Buyers using a conventional (Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac HFA Preferred) loan.
key_rules: Conventional loan
Minimum credit score is the greater of 620 or the Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac minimum
Every borrower completes a CHFA-approved homebuyer education class before closing
Income and purchase-price limits apply. See CHFA's income limits (effective June 15, 2026)

programs.name: CHFA Down Payment Assistance Grant
programs.who_its_for: Buyers using a CHFA first mortgage who need help with the down payment and closing costs.
key_rules: Up to 3% of the first mortgage amount or $25,000, whichever is less
Does not have to be repaid
Must be paired with a CHFA first mortgage loan
You can use the grant or the CHFA second mortgage, not both
programs.max_assistance: Lesser of 3% of the first mortgage or $25,000

programs.name: CHFA Down Payment Assistance Second Mortgage
programs.who_its_for: Buyers using a CHFA first mortgage who want more help than the grant offers.
key_rules: Up to 4% of the first mortgage amount or $25,000, whichever is less
0% interest with no monthly payment. Repaid when the first mortgage is paid off (including a sale or refinance) or the home stops being your primary residence
Must be paired with a CHFA first mortgage loan
You can use the second mortgage or the CHFA grant, not both
programs.max_assistance: Lesser of 4% of the first mortgage or $25,000

programs.name: CHFA Schools To Home
programs.who_its_for: Full-time employees of a Colorado preK-12 public school, school district, charter school, institute charter school, BOCES or innovation zone. This is an employment-based program.
key_rules: At least one borrower is a full-time employee of an eligible Colorado public school employer

Down payment and closing-cost help through a second mortgage of up to 25% of the first mortgage. Repayment plus a shared-appreciation payment is deferred until payoff, sale, refinance or the home stops being your primary residence
Not limited to first-time homebuyers
$1,000 minimum contribution from the borrower (may be a gift)
CHFA-approved homebuyer education required
programs.max_assistance: Up to 25% of the first mortgage (second mortgage with shared appreciation)

programs.name: CHAC Down Payment Assistance Loan
programs.who_its_for: Low- and moderate-income first-time buyers anywhere in Colorado.
key_rules: No ownership interest in residential property during the past 3 years, for every adult in the household
Income limits by county and household size. See CHAC's income limits
At least 1% of the sales price from your own funds (not a gift), plus one month of house payment in savings
Recorded as a second mortgage and repaid, usually with monthly payments
First-time homebuyer class required
programs.fit_note: Needs at least 1% of the price saved from your own money.

programs.name: FHA-insured home loan
programs.administrator: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) / FHA
programs.who_its_for: Buyers with a smaller down payment or less-than-perfect credit. Not limited to first-time buyers.
key_rules: Down payment as low as 3.5% with a credit score of 580 or higher
Scores of 500-579 need at least 10% down
The down payment can be a gift from family, an employer or a charitable organization
No maximum income limit. You need enough income to qualify for the payment

programs.name: VA-guaranteed home loan
programs.who_its_for: Veterans, service members and eligible surviving spouses with a VA Certificate of Eligibility (COE).
key_rules: In most cases no down payment is required
Needs a Certificate of Eligibility plus VA and lender credit and income standards
A down payment may be needed if you lack enough remaining entitlement

programs.name: USDA Single Family Housing Guaranteed Loan
programs.who_its_for: Low- and moderate-income buyers purchasing a primary home in a USDA-eligible rural area. Some areas outside Northern Colorado's larger cities may qualify.
key_rules: The property must be in an eligible rural area. Check the exact address on USDA's eligibility map
Household income, counting every adult, must be under the area's moderate limit (115% of area median income)
100% financing: no down payment for those who qualify
Primary residence only
programs.fit_note: Depends on the exact address. Check it on USDA's map.

programs.name: HUD Good Neighbor Next Door
programs.administrator: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)
programs.who_its_for: Law enforcement officers, preK-12 teachers, firefighters and EMTs. This is an employment-based program.
key_rules: 50% off the list price of an eligible HUD-owned home in a HUD revitalization area
You must live in the home as your primary residence for 36 months
The discount is a no-interest, no-payment second mortgage if you meet the occupancy requirement
Homes are listed for 7 days. Multiple offers are decided by random lottery. Eligible homes in any given area can be rare
programs.max_assistance: 50% discount off the list price (eligible HUD homes only)
programs.fit_note: School employees qualify only as teachers.

programs.name: Greeley-Weld Habitat for Humanity Homeownership
programs.who_its_for: Weld County households earning 30-80% of HUD's area median income who are willing to partner with Habitat.
key_rules: Have lived or worked in Weld County for at least one year
Household income between 30% and 80% of HUD's area median income
At least 150 hours of partnership volunteer hours
Selection is based on need, willingness to partner and ability to repay an affordable mortgage

programs.name: Fort Collins Habitat for Humanity Homeownership
programs.who_its_for: Households in the Fort Collins area who need affordable housing and can partner with Habitat.
key_rules: Selection is based on need, willingness to partner and ability to repay an affordable mortgage
See the affiliate's application page for current income ranges and open application periods
programs.fit_note: Confirm your town is in the affiliate's service area.

programs.name: Loveland Habitat for Humanity Homeownership
programs.who_its_for: Households in the Loveland area who need affordable housing and can partner with Habitat.
key_rules: Selection is based on need, willingness to partner and ability to repay an affordable mortgage
See the affiliate's homeownership page for current income ranges and open application periods
programs.fit_note: Confirm your town is in the affiliate's service area.

programs.name: Larimer County homebuyer resources
programs.administrator: Larimer County Office of Housing Stability
programs.who_its_for: Buyers in Larimer County looking for local down payment help, homebuyer education and partner programs.
key_rules: The county does not lend or give down payment help directly. It points buyers to regional partners that offer down payment grants and low-interest loans

programs.name: City of Greeley Housing Solutions (G-HOPE)
programs.who_its_for: Buyers looking in Greeley. The city oversees the G-HOPE down payment assistance program and says it is exploring more help for people who live or work in Greeley.
key_rules: Current G-HOPE amounts and availability could not be confirmed. Ask the city before counting on it

programs.name: CHFA homebuyer education class
programs.who_its_for: Anyone planning to use a CHFA loan or down payment help. Most programs above require it, so it is a good first step.
key_rules: Required for every borrower on a CHFA loan, completed before closing
In person (no cost) or online (eHome America, $75 per borrower unless you get a free code), in English or Spanish
Takes about 6-8 hours. The certificate is good for 12 months

not_listed.reason: The city's HBA page says it no longer provides direct homebuyer loans (only servicing existing ones).
